evals.name: oas32-stage0-plan
evals.prompt: I want to add OpenAPI 3.2.0 support to ApiDOM (parent version 3.1). Do only the research and planning step (before phase 1): produce the tracking document with the field map (new vs inherited fields per object), the external URLs we'll need, and every integration point across packages. Don't write code yet.
evals.expected_output: Tracking doc with accurate field map, verified URLs and complete cross-package integration list.
assertions: Field map names at least 20 of these 23 new OAS 3.2 fields: Components.mediaTypes; Encoding.encoding, prefixEncoding, itemEncoding; MediaType.itemSchema, prefixEncoding, itemEncoding; OAuthFlow.deviceAuthorizationUrl; OAuthFlows.deviceAuthorization; XML.nodeType; SecurityScheme.deprecated, oauth2MetadataUrl; Response.summary; Tag.summary, parent, kind; Example.dataValue, serializedValue; Discriminator.defaultMapping; Server.name; PathItem.query, additionalOperations; OpenAPI.$self
Components.pathItems, License.identifier and Info.summary are treated as inherited, not new
Does not list a webhooks field on Components
Dialect URL is https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.2/dialect/2025-09-17 (not /dialect/base)
Assigns apidom-reference parsers, resolve/dereference/bundle strategies and saturated.ts to phase 3
Lists apidom-ls parser-factory.ts and content detection in utils
Lists apidom-playground wiring
Lists the root package.json unlink script
Mentions propagating new fields to the replace-empty-element refractor plugin
States that the 3.1 adapters' detection must reject 3.2.x documents and the 3.2 adapters must reject 3.1.x (or plans a test proving it)
Plans four phases (namespace, parser adapters, apidom-reference, apidom-ls), each ending in its own PR, stacked in that order

evals.name: asyncapi31-start-at-phase-3-blocked

evals.name: arazzo-1-1-plan-unseen

fixture.note: main on 2026-10-15; apidom-ns-arazzo-1 supports 1.0.1 only. Arazzo 1.1.0 is not mentioned in any skill reference, so this measures the workflow on an unseen version (extend variant).

evals.prompt: I'd like ApiDOM to support Arazzo 1.1. Do only the research and planning step for now: the tracking document with the field map, the external URLs we need and the phase plan. Don't write code.
evals.expected_output: Extend-variant plan for apidom-ns-arazzo-1 with an accurate 1.0.1 -> 1.1.0 field map.
assertions: Identifies the extend variant: 1.1.0 goes into apidom-ns-arazzo-1 and the existing arazzo-json-1 / arazzo-yaml-1 adapters; no new namespace or adapter packages
Pins version 1.1.0 (latest 1.x release) and records the source URL of the 1.1.0 markdown

Marks at least 9 of these 10 fields as NEW: root $self; Step channelPath, timeout, correlationId, action, dependsOn; Success Action parameters; Failure Action parameters; Payload Replacement targetSelectorType; Selector Object type
Adds Selector Object (context, selector, type) as a new object
Records that Criterion Expression Type Object was renamed to Expression Type Object (same fields type, version)
Marks the value types that now accept a Selector Object as CHANGED-TYPE: Workflow outputs, Step outputs, Parameter value, Payload Replacement value
Records that Source Description type gained the value asyncapi
Does not mark inherited fields as NEW (e.g. Workflow dependsOn, Info summary, Components inputs, Failure Action retryAfter)
URL list contains only URLs that resolve (spec markdown or https://spec.openapis.org/arazzo/v1.1.0.html) and anchors taken from the page (e.g. #selector-object), not derived from a pattern
Plans four phases (namespace, parser adapters, apidom-reference, apidom-ls), each ending in its own stacked PR

evals.name: overlay-new-spec-plan-unseen

fixture.note: main on 2026-10-15; no Overlay support in ApiDOM and no skill reference mentions the Overlay Specification (brand-new spec variant). Latest release is 1.2.0.

evals.prompt: We want ApiDOM to support OpenAPI Overlay documents (https://github.com/OAI/Overlay-Specification). Do the research and planning step only: tracking document with the field map, package names, root element name, detection approach, external URLs and the phase plan. No code yet.
evals.expected_output: New-variant plan targeting Overlay 1.2.0 with all six objects and correct fields.
assertions: Targets Overlay 1.2.0 (latest release), not 1.0.0 or 1.1.0
Plans new packages apidom-ns-overlay-1, apidom-parser-adapter-overlay-json-1 and apidom-parser-adapter-overlay-yaml-1
Field map contains all six objects: Overlay, Info, Components, Action, Reusable Action, Reusable Action Reference
Overlay Object fields are exactly overlay, $self, info, extends, actions, components, with overlay, info and actions required
Action Object fields are exactly target (required), description, update, copy, remove
Reusable Action fields are description and fields; Reusable Action Reference fields are $ref (required), target (required) and description
Components has a single field actions (map of Reusable Action Objects)
Records that actions items are either an Action Object or a Reusable Action Reference Object
Records that every object allows x- specification extensions
Detection uses the overlay version field (1.x.y) and the plan checks that OpenAPI and other adapters don't claim Overlay documents
Root element name includes spec and major version (e.g. overlay1), not a bare object name
Documentation base URL is verified (https://spec.openapis.org/overlay/v1.2.0.html or the 1.2.0 markdown) with anchors taken from the page (e.g. #action-object)
Decides, with a reason, whether apidom-reference needs dereference handling for the Reusable Action Reference $ref
